The Aug 12, 2026 What's New post states the interactive map view was added to AWS Global View in the console, plots all Regions and Local Zones, can be toggled with the existing list view, and that customers previously scanned a list of AWS locations.

SEC05-BP02 common anti-patterns list both items: a perimeter-based approach that only controls traffic flow at the boundary of network layers, and controls for either ingress or egress traffic but not both.

SEC05-BP02 opening paragraph says to segment within network layers to restrict traffic to necessary flows, first north-south traffic (internet or external systems to the workload), afterwards east-west traffic between components.

SEC05-BP02 implementation guidance says security groups and route tables provide Layer 4 traffic control (IP address and port ranges) and further control comes from PrivateLink, Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall, Network Firewall and WAF.

SEC05-BP01 benefits paragraph says establishing network layers is the first step in restricting unnecessary pathways and discrete layers reduce the scope of analysis for inspection systems such as intrusion detection or malware prevention.
